final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.3.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

locals {
  drs_service_role_path = "/service-role/"

  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  partition  = data.aws_partition.current.partition

  common_tags = {
    Project   = "aws-drs-baseline"
    ManagedBy = "terraform"
  }

  # In-account, self-contained stand-ins for the AWS-managed DRS policies.
  # Nothing here references external managed policies so the stack applies
  # cleanly in a greenfield/local environment.
  drs_managed_policy_arns = {
    agent               = aws_iam_policy.drs_agent_policy.arn
    failback            = aws_iam_policy.drs_failback_policy.arn
    conversion_server   = aws_iam_policy.drs_conversion_server_policy.arn
    recovery_instance   = aws_iam_policy.drs_recovery_instance_policy.arn
    replication_server  = aws_iam_policy.drs_replication_server_policy.arn
    recovery_ssm_core   = aws_iam_policy.drs_recovery_instance_ssm_core_policy.arn
  }

  drs_role_arns = [
    aws_iam_role.drs_agent.arn,
    aws_iam_role.drs_failback.arn,
    aws_iam_role.drs_conversion_server.arn,
    aws_iam_role.drs_recovery_instance.arn,
    aws_iam_role.drs_replication_server.arn,
    aws_iam_role.drs_recovery_instance_launch_actions.arn,
  ]

  drs_service_linked_role_arn = "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:role/aws-service-role/drs.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticDisasterRecovery"

  drs_policy_arn_prefix = "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:policy/AWSElasticDisasterRecovery*"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assume-role policy documents
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "drs_agent_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AllowDRSAgentServiceToAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole", "sts:SetSourceIdentity"]

    principals {
      type        = "Service"
      identifiers = ["drs.amazonaws.com"]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:SourceAccount"
      values   = [local.account_id]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringLike"
      variable = "sts:SourceIdentity"
      values   = ["s-*"]
    }
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "drs_failback_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AllowDRSFailbackServiceToAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole", "sts:SetSourceIdentity"]

    principals {
      type        = "Service"
      identifiers = ["drs.amazonaws.com"]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:SourceAccount"
      values   = [local.account_id]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringLike"
      variable = "sts:SourceIdentity"
      values   = ["i-*"]
    }
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "ec2_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AllowEC2ServiceToAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "Service"
      identifiers = ["ec2.amazonaws.com"]
    }
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "drs_initializer_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AllowCurrentCallingIdentityToAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [data.aws_caller_identity.current.arn]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:userid"
      values   = [data.aws_caller_identity.current.user_id]
    }
  }
}

final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.4.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Variables
###############################################################################

variable "aws_region" {
  description = "AWS region into which the VPC is deployed."
  type        = string
  default     = "us-east-1"
}

variable "vpc_name" {
  description = "Name applied to the VPC and used as the prefix for derived resource names."
  type        = string
  default     = "benchmark-vpc"
}

variable "vpc_cidr" {
  description = "CIDR block assigned to the VPC."
  type        = string
  default     = "10.0.0.0/18"

  validation {
    condition     = can(cidrsubnet(var.vpc_cidr, 6, 0))
    error_message = "vpc_cidr must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length of /26 or shorter."
  }
}

variable "az_count" {
  description = "Number of availability zones to use. When null, every AZ available in the region is used."
  type        = number
  default     = null

  validation {
    condition     = var.az_count == null || (var.az_count >= 1 && floor(var.az_count) == var.az_count && var.az_count <= 32)
    error_message = "az_count must be null or a whole number between 1 and 32."
  }
}

variable "create_public_subnets" {
  description = "Whether to create public subnets, the public route table and the public network ACL."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_private_subnets" {
  description = "Whether to create private subnets, private route tables and the private network ACL."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_nat_gateway" {
  description = "Whether to create a NAT gateway so private subnets can reach the internet. Requires create_public_subnets."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

###############################################################################
# Availability zone discovery (static provider metadata only)
###############################################################################

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

###############################################################################
# Locals
###############################################################################

locals {
  common_tags = {
    Project   = var.vpc_name
    ManagedBy = "Terraform"
  }

  all_azs  = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names
  az_count = var.az_count == null ? length(local.all_azs) : min(var.az_count, length(local.all_azs))
  azs      = slice(local.all_azs, 0, local.az_count)

  # Public subnets consume the first az_count /26 blocks of the VPC CIDR.
  public_subnets = {
    for idx, az in local.azs : az => {
      cidr_block        = cidrsubnet(var.vpc_cidr, 6, idx)
      availability_zone = az
    }
    if var.create_public_subnets
  }

  # Private subnets consume the next az_count /26 blocks, so they never overlap
  # with the public subnets.
  private_subnets = {
    for idx, az in local.azs : az => {
      cidr_block        = cidrsubnet(var.vpc_cidr, 6, idx + local.az_count)
      availability_zone = az
    }
    if var.create_private_subnets
  }

  nat_gateway_enabled = var.create_nat_gateway && var.create_public_subnets
}

###############################################################################
# Guard rail: a NAT gateway can only exist when public subnets exist
###############################################################################

resource "terraform_data" "validate_nat_gateway" {
  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = !(var.create_nat_gateway && !var.create_public_subnets)
      error_message = "create_nat_gateway = true requires create_public_subnets = true, because a NAT gateway is placed in a public subnet."
    }
  }
}

###############################################################################
# VPC
###############################################################################

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = var.vpc_cidr
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = var.vpc_name
  })
}

###############################################################################
# Subnets
###############################################################################

resource "aws_subnet" "public" {
  for_each = local.public_subnets

  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = each.value.cidr_block
  availability_zone       = each.value.availability_zone
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = "${var.vpc_name}-public-${each.key}"
    Tier = "public"
  })
}

resource "aws_subnet" "private" {
  for_each = local.private_subnets

  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = each.value.cidr_block
  availability_zone       = each.value.availability_zone
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = "${var.vpc_name}-private-${each.key}"
    Tier = "private"
  })
}

###############################################################################
# Internet gateway
###############################################################################

resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = "${var.vpc_name}-igw"
  })
}

###############################################################################
# Public routing
###############################################################################

resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  count = var.create_public_subnets ? 1 : 0

  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = "${var.vpc_name}-public-rt"
    Tier = "public"
  })
}

resource "aws_route" "public_internet" {
  count = var.create_public_subnets ? 1 : 0

  route_table_id         = aws_route_table.public[0].id
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  gateway_id             = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "public" {
  for_each = local.public_subnets

  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public[each.key].id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public[0].id
}

###############################################################################
# Private routing
###############################################################################

resource "aws_route_table" "private" {
  for_each = local.private_subnets

  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = "${var.vpc_name}-private-rt-${each.key}"
    Tier = "private"
  })
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "private" {
  for_each = local.private_subnets

  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.private[each.key].id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.private[each.key].id
}

# Only created when the NAT gateway is enabled; otherwise private subnets stay
# fully isolated from the internet.
resource "aws_route" "private_nat" {
  for_each = {
    for az, subnet in local.private_subnets : az => subnet
    if local.nat_gateway_enabled
  }

  route_table_id         = aws_route_table.private[each.key].id
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  nat_gateway_id         = aws_nat_gateway.main[0].id
}

###############################################################################
# NAT gateway
###############################################################################

resource "aws_eip" "nat" {
  count = local.nat_gateway_enabled ? 1 : 0

  domain = "vpc"

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = "${var.vpc_name}-nat-eip"
  })

  depends_on = [aws_internet_gateway.main]
}

resource "aws_nat_gateway" "main" {
  count = local.nat_gateway_enabled ? 1 : 0

  allocation_id = aws_eip.nat[0].id
  subnet_id     = aws_subnet.public[local.azs[0]].id

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = "${var.vpc_name}-nat-${local.azs[0]}"
  })

  depends_on = [
    aws_internet_gateway.main,
    aws_route_table.public,
  ]
}

###############################################################################
# Network ACLs - public
###############################################################################

resource "aws_network_acl" "public" {
  count = var.create_public_subnets ? 1 : 0

  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = "${var.vpc_name}-public-nacl"
    Tier = "public"
  })
}

resource "aws_network_acl_association" "public" {
  for_each = local.public_subnets

  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public[each.key].id
  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public[0].id
}

# Ingress: only the application ports 80/443 are reachable from the internet.
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_ingress_http" {
  count = var.create_public_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public[0].id
  rule_number    = 100
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 80
  to_port        = 80
}

resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_ingress_https" {
  count = var.create_public_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public[0].id
  rule_number    = 110
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 443
  to_port        = 443
}

# Return traffic for connections initiated from inside the public subnets.
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_ingress_ephemeral" {
  count = var.create_public_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public[0].id
  rule_number    = 120
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535
}

resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_egress_http" {
  count = var.create_public_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public[0].id
  rule_number    = 100
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 80
  to_port        = 80
}

resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_egress_https" {
  count = var.create_public_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public[0].id
  rule_number    = 110
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 443
  to_port        = 443
}

resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_egress_ephemeral" {
  count = var.create_public_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public[0].id
  rule_number    = 120
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535
}

###############################################################################
# Network ACLs - private
###############################################################################

resource "aws_network_acl" "private" {
  count = var.create_private_subnets ? 1 : 0

  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = "${var.vpc_name}-private-nacl"
    Tier = "private"
  })
}

resource "aws_network_acl_association" "private" {
  for_each = local.private_subnets

  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.private[each.key].id
  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private[0].id
}

# ---- Private ingress -------------------------------------------------------
# Intra-VPC TCP traffic (application ports) and the matching ephemeral range,
# scoped to the VPC CIDR only. Expressed as a concrete protocol because an
# all-protocol ("-1") allow rule is disallowed.
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_ingress_vpc_tcp" {
  count = var.create_private_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private[0].id
  rule_number    = 100
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = var.vpc_cidr
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535
}

# Intra-VPC UDP traffic (e.g. DNS responses from the VPC resolver).
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_ingress_vpc_udp" {
  count = var.create_private_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private[0].id
  rule_number    = 110
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "udp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = var.vpc_cidr
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535

resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_ingress_return" {
  count = var.create_private_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private[0].id
  rule_number    = 120
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535
}

# Intra-VPC TCP traffic (application ports) and the matching ephemeral range,
# scoped to the VPC CIDR only.
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_egress_vpc_tcp" {
  count = var.create_private_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private[0].id
  rule_number    = 100
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = var.vpc_cidr
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535
}

# Intra-VPC UDP traffic (e.g. DNS queries to the VPC resolver).
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_egress_vpc_udp" {
  count = var.create_private_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private[0].id
  rule_number    = 110
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "udp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = var.vpc_cidr
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535

# Outbound updates and package retrieval through the NAT gateway.
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_egress_http" {
  count = var.create_private_subnets ? 1 : 0

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private[0].id
  rule_number    = 120
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private[0].id

  rule_number    = 140

final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.3.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables (all have defaults so `terraform apply` runs unattended)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
variable "aws_region" {
  description = "AWS region used when composing regional ARNs for this stack."
  type        = string
  default     = "us-east-1"
}

variable "project" {
  description = "Project identifier applied to every tag map."
  type        = string
  default     = "iam-access-management"
}

variable "additional_tags" {
  description = "Extra tags merged into the common tag map."
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Static provider metadata (no infrastructure lookups)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

locals {
  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  partition  = "aws"
  region     = var.aws_region

  common_tags = merge(
    {
      Project   = var.project
      ManagedBy = "terraform"
    },
    var.additional_tags
  )

  # Bucket/queue name prefixes are account derived so policy ARNs stay
  # scoped to resources owned by this account instead of global wildcards.
  github_s3_prefix     = "github-${local.account_id}-"
  serverless_s3_prefix = "serverless-${local.account_id}-"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Group: admin ("/admin/") -- INTENTIONAL BREAK-GLASS ADMINISTRATOR
# Note: aws_iam_group is not a taggable resource in the AWS provider schema,
# so no tags block is applied here.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_group" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
  path = "/admin/"
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "admin" {
  name  = "admin"
  group = aws_iam_group.admin.name

  # DELIBERATE BROAD GRANT: the "admin" group is the account break-glass
  # administrator group. Full wildcard Action "*" with Resource "*" is an
  # explicit, intentional requirement for this group and must never be
  # narrowed without a documented exception.
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid      = "FullAdministrativeAccess"
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = "*"
        Resource = "*"
      }
    ]
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Group: admin-terraform-cloud ("/admin_terraform_cloud/")
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_group" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  name = "admin-terraform-cloud"
  path = "/admin_terraform_cloud/"
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  name  = "admin-terraform-cloud"
  group = aws_iam_group.admin_terraform_cloud.name

  # DELIBERATE BROAD GRANT: this group backs the Terraform Cloud automation
  # identity, which must be able to manage every resource type in the
  # account. The wildcard Action "*" / Resource "*" pairing is intentional.
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
